title: Aurora Watch
text:
🌌 Aurora Watch — October 04, 2026

The geomagnetic ingredients are coming together: elevated Kp, southward Bz, and faster solar wind have Sunny's attention.

🌎 Kp: 4.33 (Elevated)
🧲 IMF Bz: -14.7 nT (Southward)
💨 Solar wind: 461 km/s (Elevated)
🚨 NOAA: ALERT: Geomagnetic K-index of 4
☀️ Solar driver context: CH-HSS

Okay, this could get pretty. 👀✨

Aurora visibility still depends on location, darkness, cloud cover, and how the magnetic field evolves from here. ✨

Image: NOAA SWPC — OVATION Aurora Forecast
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
